chapter: New York clubs and return home
title: The Capitol Palace, the Cotton Club and Piron's band in New York
summary: Back from Europe she worked at the Capitol and Cotton Club. Piron's New Orleans band disappointed the Cotton Club audience, and she lists the other clubs she worked.
